title: Fixing a bike puncture
examples: What kind of tools do I need for a puncture?
Is it better to patch or replace the tube?
How do I make sure the tire is clean before patching?

explain.say: First you need to use tyre levers to get the tyre off the rim.
Next you need to find the puncture hole on the inner tube.
Once you find the hole you must clean the area well.
Then you apply the patch carefully over the hole.
For a real life example you can check a garden hose for leaks.
A common mistake is not checking the tyre for sharp objects.

faq.q: Do I need to take the wheel off the bike?
faq.a: It is best to remove the wheel to work safely. This keeps your hands clear and gives you more space to work.
asks: Should I take the bike apart first?
Is it necessary to remove the wheel?

faq.q: How do I know if the patch will actually work?
faq.a: The area around the hole must be clean and dry for the glue to stick properly. If it is dirty, the patch will fail.
asks: What makes a good patch bond?
What if the hole is too big?

faq.q: What if the puncture is really big?
faq.a: If the hole is very large, it might be safer to replace the tube entirely. Patches are best for smaller punctures.
asks: Can I patch a huge hole?
When should I just buy a new tube?

faq.q: What is the right way to use the tyre levers?
faq.a: You must work the levers gently under the tyre bead. Do not use sharp objects that could damage the rim.
asks: How do I get the tyre off without damaging it?
What is the safest way to use levers?

faq.q: Do I need to use soap and water to find the leak?
faq.a: Yes, soapy water is a good way to find slow leaks. You look for the stream of bubbles forming in the water.
asks: What liquid works best for finding air leaks?
Can I just listen for the air escaping?

facts: Tyre levers are used to separate the tyre from the rim.
A small amount of water mixed with soap helps locate air leaks.
The patch adhesive needs time to dry and bond before patching.
It is important to check the tyre casing for the object that caused the puncture.

quiz.say: What is the first tool you use to get the tyre off the rim?
quiz.why: Tyre levers are specifically designed to pry the tyre bead away from the wheel rim.

wrong.1: A strong stick might damage the delicate rim or the tyre itself.
wrong.2: Your hands can easily get cut on the sharp edges of the tyre or rim.
wrong.3: Knives are too sharp and risk cutting you or damaging the tube.

quiz.say: If you find a leak, what should you use to find it?
quiz.why: The bubbles formed by soapy water clearly show where the air is escaping.

wrong.1: Small leaks can make very little noise, making them hard to detect by sound alone.
wrong.2: Smoke detectors are for smoke, not for detecting small amounts of escaping air.
wrong.3: A vacuum cleaner is too powerful and might damage the tube when used this way.

quiz.say: After applying the patch, what must you do before inflating fully?
quiz.why: Allowing the glue to dry and bond properly ensures the patch sticks strongly and lasts.

wrong.1: Inflating too soon can lift the patch or prevent the glue from bonding fully.
wrong.2: Rubbing too hard before the glue sets can tear the soft adhesive underneath.
wrong.3: Dipping it in water will wash away the glue you just applied.
